description: Skill for curating cancer and neoplastic disease entries in the dismech knowledge base. Use this skill when creating or enhancing cancer entries, adding oncogene/tumor suppressor pathophysiology, curating histopathology findings, adding targeted therapy information, and linking genetic drivers to treatment responses. Covers fusion genes, two-hit hypothesis, oncogene addiction, and precision oncology concepts.
